payload.preserved: Small ASR / 3 threads / every other GUI and business option / persona / presentation / playback and capture policy

details: Exact 13 actual public source/binary payload hashes, native build receipt and paired selection validate.
Unknown/missing/tampered payload, receipt, changed ASR settings and business/gui option overrides reject.
Persona/presentation/unrelated runtime pin changes reject; ARM64 ELF and formal selection constant match.
Actual GUI assignment changes only nested selection SHA; complete old config is otherwise preserved.
Original apply read/create/replace helpers, normal-closed/no-force journal, publisher/writer locks, bootstrap/private root and complete source checks remain.
Start/ready source() alone changes native binding; all other publisher functions are AST-identical.
The v16 no-object capture exception accepts only never-armed PAUSED/mic=false/recording IDLE/task DISABLED/no fault/no pending metadata. Active/fault/pending/previously armed cases reject.

root_commands: Complete the separately planned controlled native preview; if not accepted, restore original v16 while it is still unchanged.
execution_notes: Commands are interfaces for the main owner, not actions executed by this subagent. Omit --execute-root-only for source-only dry validation.
Root keeps explicit user PAUSED preference. The original ready_state reads and enforces that preference; this candidate never opens a mic itself.

Guard/normal-close use the old v16 native check. Start/ready require spec.native_library_sha256 to equal the fixed new reviewed native SHA and the actual startup component pin. The check is not removed.
apply creates only a new isolated v17_spec.json after a successful remote result. Original acceptance/spec.json and both upstream scripts are never edited.
The 13 payloads exclude the separately regenerated GUI config and original startup/source-manifest journals. No invented startup character_pair field is written.
Receipt validates compiled CPU facial-policy evidence only. Actual preview/FPS/physical dialogue acceptance remains a separate root decision.

Publication retains the upstream backup/intent/fsync replacement order. A partial failure leaves the normal-close guard in place; do not run start against incomplete pins or retry the same stage blindly. Root must inspect the owned stage journal/backup and recover deliberately.
No rollback, service stop/kill/restart, model, database content replay, permission changes or private-file export is added.
